solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Gloomy study to get one down

parts.note: a den is a private study or retreat

explanation.surface: A miserable student whose reading leaves them depressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gloomy study' reads as one phrase about a dull room; it splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To get someone down is to depress them, making them unhappy: a phrasal synonym.

clue.text: Altering a ruling's exceptional

indicators.note: altering means changing, so these letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Changing a judge's decision is a rare event.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'ruling's' supplies an S to the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Something singular is remarkable or unusual, standing out from the ordinary: a synonym.

clue.text: Gift to people after a party

indicators.note: after puts the people piece following the party piece

parts.note: a do is an informal word for a party

explanation.surface: Presents handed out to guests after a celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift given to a charity or cause is a contribution, a synonym.

clue.text: It's always right to follow the first mate

indicators.note: to follow puts the right piece after the mate piece

parts.note: Eve was the first wife, Adam's mate in Genesis

explanation.surface: A sailor insists rank always defers to the first mate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First mate' looks naval; it is Eve, the first woman, mate of Adam.
explanation.definitionFit: Ever means at all times, perpetually, as in 'ever faithful': a synonym.

clue.text: Shared a good round of golf?

definitions.meaning: had a share in, joined in
a round at par, the expected score, is a good one: split as a phrase it says par was taken

explanation.surface: Two golfers splitting the credit for a decent round.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the second reading as a pun: PAR TAKEN, a par score achieved, is a good round.
explanation.definitionFit: To partake is to take part or have a share, so things partaken were shared out.

clue.text: Vulnerable spot targeted by Paris

parts.note: in Greek legend the Trojan prince Paris shot the hero of Troy's siege in his one weak point, the back of his foot

explanation.surface: A weak spot targeted in the French capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Paris' suggests the city; it is the Trojan prince whose arrow struck the hero.
explanation.definitionFit: Achilles was invulnerable except at the heel, where Paris's arrow killed him, so it means a single weakness.

clue.text: Set up issue of US magazine

indicators.note: set up in a down clue means the word is written upward, read in reverse

parts.note: to emit is to issue or send out

explanation.surface: Preparing the latest issue of an American magazine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Issue' looks like an edition of the magazine; it is the verb to send out.
explanation.definitionFit: This weekly American news periodical, founded in 1923, is one of the best known US magazines.

clue.text: Champion one may play with on board

definitions.meaning: a medieval champion fighting for a cause, a mounted warrior

definitions.text: one may play with on board
definitions.meaning: a chess piece moved on the board

explanation.surface: A sporting victor who joins in a board game.
explanation.definitionFit: A knight was an armoured champion in battle, and is also the horse-headed piece in chess.

clue.text: A number smash up the inn, yet set free

indicators.note: smash up means wreck, breaking the letters apart for rearranging
set free tells the letters to be released from their order and placed anew

explanation.surface: Vandals wreck a pub, yet are released without charge.
explanation.walkthrough: Both 'smash up' and 'set free' signal the anagram of INN YET; 'the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a cardinal figure, nine tens, so it counts as a number.

clue.text: Anne's going out with North Polar explorer

indicators.note: going out suggests leaving a settled state, so the letters of Anne's are rearranged

parts.note: N is the compass abbreviation for North

explanation.surface: Anne is dating a man from the frozen north who explores.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Going out with' looks like Anne is dating someone; 'going out' is really the signal to scramble her name, and 'with' joins on the compass point.
explanation.definitionFit: Fridtjof Nansen was the Norwegian explorer who crossed Greenland and led a famous Arctic expedition.

clue.text: Support excellent hero

definitions.meaning: to ... a cause is to back or support it
an old informal British adjective meaning first-rate
a hero or defender of others

explanation.surface: Cheering on a brilliant protagonist.
explanation.walkthrough: Three definitions in a row: a verb, an adjective (northern English 'that's champion!') and a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: The one word works as verb, adjective and noun, matching backing, first-rate quality and a heroic figure.

clue.text: What missionaries tried to do in other ways?

definitions.meaning: split as two words it says change the indigenous people, which missionaries attempted
different options or choices

explanation.surface: Asking how missionaries tried other methods.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the pun: ALTER NATIVES, change local people.
explanation.definitionFit: Different options open to someone are choices or substitutes, a plural noun synonym.

clue.text: So far fit for the job

definitions.meaning: as in '... now', meaning until this point
as in 'not ... it', meaning capable of the task

explanation.surface: An interim report that someone has coped with the work so far.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means until now in time, and capable or equal to a task when describing a person.

clue.text: Some found needlessly lying in a cunning way

indicators.note: some says only part of the following words is wanted, a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: Someone discovered telling pointless lies with crafty intent.
explanation.walkthrough: The run spans the end of 'needlessly' and the start of 'lying'.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something cunningly is doing it craftily or in a sly manner: an adverbial synonym.

clue.text: Talk of Tom in Paris

definitions.meaning: an informal talk
a tom is a male cat, and the French word for cat is used in Paris

explanation.surface: Gossip about a man named Tom who lives in France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tom' looks like a person's name; it is a tomcat, and 'in Paris' asks for the French word.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal conversation is a natter, and the French for a cat is the same spelling.

clue.text: Thread starts to burn in the flames

indicators.note: in puts the opening letter inside the flames piece

parts.note: a fire is made of flames

indicators.note: starts to asks for the opening letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A strand of yarn catches alight in the blaze.
explanation.definitionFit: A fibre is a slender strand of material, like a thread: a synonym.

clue.text: I note and see love in the home

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see
love is zero in tennis, which looks like an O

explanation.surface: Someone sees romance and music in the family house.
explanation.definitionFit: This domed snow house is the traditional winter dwelling of Inuit people, so it is a home.

clue.text: Geometry I can make a source of power

indicators.note: make here means form something new out of these letters, rearranging them

explanation.surface: A maths student boasts that geometry can generate energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make' rearranges GEOMETRY plus ICAN into the twelve letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Nuclear power from splitting atoms is a major source of electricity for national grids.

clue.text: Eternal description of the unwatched?

definitions.meaning: everlasting, never ending
someone without a wristwatch is, read literally, without a clock

explanation.surface: An everlasting quality of things nobody looks at.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unwatched' suggests unobserved; the question mark flags the pun of having no watch.
explanation.definitionFit: Lasting forever and unaffected by the passing years is to be everlasting: a synonym.

clue.text: Changes in heat and rent are imminent

indicators.note: changes in says the letters of the following words are altered in order

explanation.surface: A warning that heating and rent bills are about to rise.
explanation.definitionFit: When storms or dangers loom they are about to happen, as in 'rain threatens': a verb phrase synonym.

clue.text: Sleek coat shows Parisian chic

parts.note: polish means refinement or elegance, close to chic

explanation.surface: A smart coat displays Paris style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coat' suggests clothing; it is a coat of shellac varnish on furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: This shellac finish gives wooden furniture a glossy, smooth layer, so it is a sleek coating.

clue.text: Possibly secure and free from danger

indicators.note: possibly says the letters given are one arrangement, and another is wanted

explanation.surface: Making something safe and saving it from harm.
explanation.definitionFit: To save someone or something from a threat is to free it from danger: a verb synonym.

clue.text: In radiography sickness has a cure

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the following words, across their boundary

explanation.surface: Radiation sickness from X-rays has a treatment.
explanation.definitionFit: Physic is an old word for medicine or a remedy, so it means a cure.

clue.text: A resounding come back

parts.note: a sound that bounces back off a surface is a come-back that literally resounds

explanation.surface: A decisive return, as of a sports team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Resounding comeback' suggests a triumphant return; read literally it is a sound coming back.
explanation.definitionFit: A reflected sound returns to the listener, literally a sound coming back again.

clue.text: A good man always in control

parts.note: ST, short for saint, is the crossword good man
e'er is the poetic contraction of ever, meaning always

explanation.surface: A virtuous person who is never out of control.
explanation.walkthrough: E'ER is poetic for 'ever'; its apostrophe is ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: To guide or direct a vehicle or course is to take control of it: a verbal synonym.

clue.text: We are — or used to be

definitions.meaning: the past form of 'we are' replaces the verb with this word
the past plural of the verb to be describes what used to be

explanation.surface: A wistful remark about who we are now, or who we once were.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the past plural of the verb to be, so it states being in former times.

clue.text: Cut price bargain

definitions.meaning: a small cut made with scissors
British informal for something bought cheaply

explanation.surface: An item at a discount, a real deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut price' reads as one phrase meaning discounted; it splits into two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: A snip is a small clip with scissors, and British slang for a purchase at a very good price.

clue.text: Dread a change in the fare

indicators.note: a change in says the letters of the following word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A passenger dreads a rise in the ticket price.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the' is a link word between indicator and fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Dread is strong anxiety about what may happen, a synonym of being afraid.

clue.text: Italian man of affairs

parts.note: a man of affairs sounds like a businessman, but here the affairs are love affairs of a Venetian seducer

explanation.surface: An Italian businessman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man of affairs' suggests business dealings; the affairs are romantic.
explanation.definitionFit: Giacomo Casanova, an eighteenth-century Venetian, became a byword for a serial seducer.

clue.text: Refuse to accept an imperfect article

definitions.meaning: to turn down or decline
a faulty item discarded in manufacture, a second

explanation.surface: A shopper declining to take faulty goods.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to turn down; as a noun, a flawed product sent back from the factory line.

clue.text: Dunce's cap is maybe part of break with reality

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Wearing a dunce's cap might be a way of escaping the real world.
explanation.definitionFit: Retreating into fantasy or diversion is a mental break from everyday reality, a noun synonym.

clue.text: Up and about when a siren has been set off

indicators.note: set off suggests the alarm sounding, but here it means the letters of a siren are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is awake once an alarm siren has sounded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set off' looks like an alarm triggering; it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Having got up out of bed, a person is risen and active, the past participle used as an adjective.
